t_advice_summary_textbox.text: THe amount of mushrooms varies each round. They found that picking the gnome with the biggest hat yielded the best results.

vb_textbox.text: Generally I found that the gnome with the bigger hat gave more mushrooms, but the number of mushrooms in the forest varies, so it's not always a very high number. The gnomes are consistent though, so once you figure out which one gives more it'll stay the same. Good luck!
